user_query: We are planning a Phase 3 randomised controlled trial of a next-generation proteasome inhibitor in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, targeting patients with 2–3 prior lines of therapy including lenalidomide and a prior PI. The trial will be conducted globally across the US, EU, and Asia-Pacific. We are seeking FDA and EMA label claims and will need NICE and ICER submissions. The mechanism involves weekly IV administration with step-up dosing in Cycle 1. Our TPP focuses on improvement in bone pain and physical functioning, but we also need to capture fatigue and treatment tolerability. Please generate a full COA strategy.
answer:
## COA Measurement Strategy — Multiple Myeloma Phase 3

**In one sentence:** This Phase 3 proteasome inhibitor trial requires PRO endpoints to demonstrate bone pain relief and physical functioning improvement in RRMM patients, supporting FDA/EMA labelling claims and HTA cost-effectiveness analysis.

**Key challenge:** No suitable validated instruments for disease-related bone pain are identified in the current candidate matrix, yet bone pain is both a core FDA domain and the primary TPP claim.

**Recommended starting point:**  BPI-SF for bone pain (validated in myeloma populations with bone metastases) , BFI for fatigue (change detected in KG), and PRO-CTCAE for treatment tolerability, but critical gaps remain for physical functioning and core FDA domains.

**Critical gap:**  EQ-5D-5L missing from candidate instruments  despite being mandatory for NICE and ICER HTA submissions.

## Table 1: Domain Coverage Comparison

| FDA Core Concept | Source | Current Trial Candidates | IKEMA [2021] | TOURMALINE-MM3 [2021] | A.R.R.O.W. [2021] |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Disease-related bone pain | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | No instrument found | ❌ Not collected | ❌ Not collected | ❌ Not collected |
| Physical functioning | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | No instrument found | EORTC QLQ-C30 ⚠️ General: NR | EORTC QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: Y | EORTC QLQ-C30 ⚠️ General: Partial |
| Fatigue | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | BFI (score 68, change: Yes) | ❌ Not collected | ❌ Not collected | ❌ Not collected |
| Symptomatic adverse events | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | No instrument found | ❌ Not collected | ❌ Not collected | CSQ-8 ✅ Change: Y |
| Side effect impact summary | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | No instrument found | ❌ Not collected | ❌ Not collected | ❌ Not collected |
| Role functioning | FDA 2024 Core PRO Guidance | No instrument found | EORTC QLQ-C30 ⚠️ General: NR | EORTC QLQ-C30 ✅ Change: Y | EORTC QLQ-C30 ⚠️ General: Partial |
| HTA Utility | NICE/ICER Requirements | No KG scoring data available | EQ-5D-5L ✅ Change: NR | ❌ Not collected | EQ-5D-5L ✅ Change: Y |

## Table 2: PRO Measures Comparison

| Trial | Year | Drug | Drug class | PRO Measures (n items) | Calibrated SOA | Total items | Est. time |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| IKEMA [TI-001] | 2021 | carfilzomib | Proteasome Inhibitor | EORTC QLQ-C30 (30), QLQ-MY20 (20), EQ-5D-5L (6) | No | 56 | 24-27 min |
| TOURMALINE-MM4 [TI-002] | 2021 | ixazomib | Proteasome Inhibitor | EORTC QLQ-C30 (30), QLQ-MY20 (20) | No | 50 | 17-22 min |
| TOURMALINE-MM3 [TI-003] | 2021 | ixazomib | Proteasome Inhibitor | EORTC QLQ-C30 (30), QLQ-MY20 (20) | No | 50 | 17-22 min |
| A.R.R.O.W. [TI-004] | 2021 | carfilzomib | Proteasome Inhibitor | CSQ-8 (8), EORTC QLQ-C30 (30), QLQ-MY20 (20), EQ-5D-5L (6) | No | 64 | 26-30 min |
| ENDEAVOR [TI-005] | 2021 | carfilzomib | Proteasome Inhibitor | EORTC QLQ-C30 (30), FACT/GOG-NTX (6), QLQ-MY20 (20) | No | 56 | 24-27 min |
| Current Trial (Proposed) | 2026 | Next-gen PI | Proteasome Inhibitor | BFI (9), PRO-CTCAE (n=?), EQ-5D-5L (6) | TBD — expert decision required | 15+ | 6-9+ min |

## Key Observations

•  In 61 KG trials for this indication, 96% used PRO as secondary endpoints, 3% as exploratory, with 0 primary PRO endpoints . This suggests secondary positioning is the regulatory standard for proteasome inhibitors in RRMM. •  BPI-SF has been validated specifically in multiple myeloma populations with bone metastases , addressing the critical bone pain domain gap identified in the candidate matrix, though requiring addition to the instrument panel. •  TOURMALINE-MM3 and A.R.R.O.W. demonstrated significant changes in EORTC QLQ-C30 , providing evidence that physical functioning domains can be detected with this instrument in proteasome inhibitor trials. •  A.R.R.O.W. used CSQ-8 for symptomatic adverse events with significant results (p<0.001) , but  CSQ-8 is not accepted by FDA/EMA as a drug labelling instrument , requiring PRO-CTCAE substitution for regulatory compliance. •  IKEMA and A.R.R.O.W. both included EQ-5D-5L , establishing precedent for utility measurement in carfilzomib Phase 3 trials and addressing the mandatory HTA requirement. • Total proposed instrument burden (15+ items, 6-9+ minutes) is substantially lower than comparator trials (50-64 items, 17-30 minutes), potentially improving completion rates but requiring validation of domain coverage adequacy.

## Comparator Analysis

| Comparator | Mechanism | PRO Instruments | Outcome | Implication |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| carfilzomib (IKEMA) | Proteasome Inhibitor | EORTC QLQ-C30, QLQ-MY20, EQ-5D-5L | Not reported | Establishes instrument precedent but outcome unclear |
| ixazomib (TOURMALINE-MM3) | Proteasome Inhibitor | EORTC QLQ-C30, QLQ-MY20 | Significant (p<0.05) both instruments | Strong evidence for EORTC sensitivity in PI trials |
| carfilzomib (A.R.R.O.W.) | Proteasome Inhibitor | CSQ-8, EORTC QLQ-C30, QLQ-MY20, EQ-5D-5L | Significant CSQ-8 (p<0.001), partial QLQ-C30, significant MY20/EQ-5D (p<0.01) | Mixed results suggest instrument-specific sensitivity differences |
| carfilzomib (ENDEAVOR) | Proteasome Inhibitor | EORTC QLQ-C30, FACT/GOG-NTX, QLQ-MY20 | Significant QLQ-C30/FACT-NTX (p<0.001), partial MY20 | Confirms QLQ-C30 sensitivity, establishes neuropathy measurement precedent |

 Based on comparator evidence, EORTC QLQ-C30 has the strongest signal of change in this indication because TOURMALINE-MM3 achieved significance across both QLQ-C30 and MY20 in ixazomib RRMM patients .

## HTA Requirements

| HTA Body | Required Instrument | In candidate list? | Action needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| NICE/ICER | EQ-5D-5L | ❌ No | Mandatory addition for cost-utility analysis |

## What the Expert Needs to Decide

1. Whether to add BPI-SF to address the bone pain domain gap, as it has specific validation in myeloma bone metastases but is not in the current candidate matrix.
2. Whether to include EORTC QLQ-C30 to capture physical/role functioning domains based on strong comparator evidence, despite not appearing in the scoring system.
3. Positioning within testing hierarchy — all comparator evidence supports secondary endpoint placement for PRO measures in proteasome inhibitor trials.
4. Assessment schedule frequency aligned with weekly IV dosing and step-up protocol requirements.
5. Whether the proposed minimal instrument panel (BFI, PRO-CTCAE, EQ-5D-5L) adequately covers FDA core domains or requires EORTC addition for regulatory defensibility.
